status: PROPOSAL — not loaded by index.cjs, not read by the Script Lab, nothing executes it

source.document: docs/pods/pod-union-coverage-2026-08-31.md — the union-coverage read that produced this list
source.corpus: canonical_pod_scenarios where pod_slug = 'method-pod-43-scene' (and the same scenes in 'method-pod-chapters' / 'learning-flagship' where noted)
source.method: Every 43-scene chapter carries a walk declaration. These ten declared shape names resolve to nothing in the store AND to nothing in proposed/talk-bollocks-additions-2026-08-30.json. Each candidate below is the pod's own declared name with a one-line gloss read from the scene it stages — not a corpus derivation. Ratification, including whether each is a node or a move, is Tom's.

id_range.rule: N901 upward — 1xx–5xx are held by the health/outcome-mint/talk-bollocks/ireland/trades proposals, 6xx by care work, 7xx by retail, 8xx reserved by hospitality. 9xx was free on 2026-08-31.

schema_note: Deliberately does not validate against schemas/metagraph-v1-schema.json: candidates carry no positions[] because splitting a shape into positions is ratification work, not measurement work.

candidates.gloss: An estimate is asked for; the answerer flags the guess as a guess before giving it ('I'm out of practice, and I haven't thought about it much… but'), then commits to a concrete number under the flag. The flag licenses the precision.

A theory is dismantled by making its proponent state it in full until its complexity is self-refuting ('listen to yourself — it gets complicated very fast'). The verdict is one line; the work was done by the restatement.

A position held for years is recanted at full strength, jointly, with the old position quoted and no face-saving hedge. Distinct from N15 (nothing is parked) and O8 (nobody disagrees — both parties abandon together).
A tease is returned in the same shape it arrived in, and the mirroring is the ratification of the relationship. Adjacent to N10 Compliment but the currency is mock-attack, not praise.
One speaker's metaphor is taken up and driven further by the other, with the handover named ('now you're driving my metaphor' / 'you gave me the keys'). The image becomes joint property.
Several distinct asks are stacked into one turn and accepted in one word. Named a summit shape by the 2026-08-30 re-read; never minted by the talk-bollocks extraction.

A listener's paraphrase is refused ('that's not what I'm saying') and replaced, and the conversation continues on the corrected reading. The discursive sibling of N6 Repair: what fails is interpretation, not transmission.

A grievance about the world is voiced and the partner completes it rather than answering it ('…and gives nothing back' — 'Nothing'). The listed sibling of O7, but here the disclosure is met and built on, not merely survived.
An anecdote is answered with a structurally matching anecdote, and the match itself carries the claim ('two days, a year apart' / 'sixteen months apart'). No verdict turn exists or is owed.

Mid-story, the listener supplies the story's own name for itself ('that's literally how cancer works') and the teller ratifies it and builds on the naming. A summit shape of the 2026-08-30 re-read; never minted.

explicitly_not_minted: Scene 2's 'anecdote-with-flag, challenged' — its flag line IS F302 ('It proves nothing — accept it anyway') verbatim; if F302 is ratified the scene is F302's attestation, not a new shape.
Scenes 25/26 ('concession-then-build', 'the counterexample absorbed') — both read as F305 'Absorb and build'; same condition.

Scene 4's 'flagged digression and return' — that is proposed N302; today it aliases to N6 Repair via the /reformulation/ regex in tools/pods/pod-shape-aliases.cjs, which is arguably the one over-mapping in the current instrument.
